adamantine_scales.name: Adamantine Scales
adamantine_scales.narrative: Nearly indestructible scales from fish that dwell in volcanic springs. Incredibly heat-resistant.

air_crystal.name: Air Crystal
air_crystal.narrative: Pale crystal that drifts upward if not secured. Contains compressed winds.

alchemy_table_t1.narrative: Wooden workbench fitted with glass vials, copper cauldrons, and measuring instruments. This is where plants become potions and careful mixing creates powerful effects.

alchemy_table_t2.name: Steel Alchemy Table
alchemy_table_t2.narrative: Advanced alchemy station with steel vessels and crystal-infused apparatus. Handles volatile reactions with ease. The fire crystals maintain precise temperature control.

alchemy_table_t3.narrative: Master alchemy laboratory with crystalline distillation chambers and self-regulating temperature controls.

alchemy_table_t4.narrative: Legendary alchemy apparatus that bends the laws of chemistry. Can create potions that defy natural law.

armor_polish.name: Armor Polish
armor_polish.narrative: Polish that makes armor gleam and deflect attacks. Knights pay fortunes for this. The sheen isn't just for show - it actually turns blades.

ash_log.name: Ash Log
ash_log.narrative: Pale wood with excellent shock absorption. Weapon handles made from ash feel alive in your grip.

ash_plank.name: Ash Plank
ash_plank.narrative: Refined ash planks with superior shock absorption properties.

basalt.name: Basalt
basalt.narrative: Dense metamorphic rock with distinctive banding. Exceptional compression strength.

basic_arrow_turret.description: Basic arrow turret using simple springs and levers. Point away from face. Automated defense that never sleeps, never misses... well, rarely misses.

basic_arrow_turret.name: Basic Arrow Turret
basic_arrow_turret.narrative: Basic arrow turret using simple springs and levers. Point away from face. Automated defense that never sleeps, never misses... well, rarely misses.

bear_trap.effect: Triggers on contact, 25 damage + immobilize for 5 seconds
bear_trap.name: Bear Trap
bear_trap.narrative: Bear trap with brutal steel jaws. Immobilizes anything that steps on it. The teeth dig deep and don't let go.

beetle_carapace.name: Beetle Carapace
beetle_carapace.narrative: Iridescent shell segment. Lightweight yet remarkably impact-resistant.

birch_log.name: Birch Log
birch_log.narrative: Creamy-white wood from elegant trees. Highly valued for its fine grain and excellent carving properties.

birch_plank.name: Birch Plank
birch_plank.narrative: Refined birch planks, perfect for detailed craftwork.

blast_powder.effect: Used in engineering recipes for bombs and explosives
blast_powder.name: Blast Powder
blast_powder.narrative: Explosive powder from concentrated elemental volatility. Handle with extreme care. Do not shake, drop, or look at funny. Used in engineering recipes for bombs and explosives.

bronze_ingot.name: Bronze Ingot
bronze_ingot.narrative: Bronze alloy forged from copper and tin. Stronger than either parent metal, the ancient alloy that built civilizations. The first lesson in combining materials.

chaos_matrix.name: Chaos Matrix
chaos_matrix.narrative: Solidified probability space. Can be shaped into predetermined or random outcomes.

chaos_scales.name: Chaos Scales
chaos_scales.narrative: Reality-warping scales that shift color unpredictably. Each one contains a fragment of pure chaos.

cluster_bomb.description: Cluster bomb that splits into multiple explosives. Maximum coverage. One becomes many, the sky rains destruction.

cluster_bomb.name: Cluster Bomb
cluster_bomb.narrative: Cluster bomb that splits into multiple explosives. Maximum coverage. One becomes many, the sky rains destruction.

common_scales.name: Common Scales
common_scales.narrative: Dull bronze-green scales from common freshwater fish. Surprisingly durable and often used in basic crafting.

copper_ingot.name: Copper Ingot
copper_ingot.narrative: Refined copper shaped into usable ingots. Malleable, forgiving for beginner crafters, accepts enchantments readily.

copper_ore.name: Copper Ore
copper_ore.narrative: A soft, reddish metal found in shallow veins near the surface. Easy to work with basic tools but lacks the durability needed for serious combat. The foundation of all smithing - every blacksmith's first lesson.

crystal_quartz.name: Crystal Quartz
crystal_quartz.narrative: Translucent crystal that amplifies magical energies passing through it. Hums softly when near power sources.

diamond.name: Diamond
diamond.narrative: Perfect crystalline structure that refracts reality itself. Entire fortunes built on single specimens.

dire_fang.name: Dire Fang
dire_fang.narrative: Razor-sharp fang from alpha predators. Still warm from the kill.

earth_crystal.name: Earth Crystal
earth_crystal.narrative: Green-brown crystal with swirling sediment. Surprisingly heavy, grounds magical energies.

ebony_log.name: Ebony Log
ebony_log.narrative: Deep black wood from ancient forests. Absorbs and nullifies magical energies.

ebony_plank.name: Ebony Plank
ebony_plank.narrative: Refined ebony planks, perfect for anti-magic applications.

efficiency_oil.effect: Apply to tools for +15% gathering speed for 1 hour
efficiency_oil.name: Efficiency Oil
efficiency_oil.narrative: Oil that makes tools work faster and smoother. Craftsmen swear by this formula. Apply it before work and watch efficiency soar.

elemental_harmony_potion.name: Elemental Harmony Potion
elemental_harmony_potion.narrative: Combining all basic elements into a harmony potion. Balance in a bottle. All elemental forces recognize you as kin and refuse to harm their own.

emp_device.narrative: EMP device that disables electronic enemies and devices. Technology's worst nightmare. Lightning contained, waiting to be unleashed.

enchanting_table_t1.narrative: Stone pedestal inlaid with crystalline channels that pulse with latent energy. Place items here and inscribe patterns of power to enhance them. Where mundane becomes magical.

enchanting_table_t2.narrative: Advanced enchanting table surrounded by floating crystals. Channels magical energies with precision.

enchanting_table_t3.name: Master Enchanting Altar
enchanting_table_t3.narrative: Master enchanting table with floating crystal matrices and perfect rune alignment tools.

enchanting_table_t4.name: Nexus of Enchantment
enchanting_table_t4.narrative: Legendary enchanting nexus that taps into the fabric of reality itself. Can imbue items with powers beyond mortal understanding.

engineering_bench_t1.narrative: Sturdy iron workbench equipped with precision tools, vises, and gear assemblies. Here mechanisms take shape - springs tension, gears mesh, devices come to life.

engineering_bench_t2.narrative: Advanced engineering station with steel construction and precision measuring tools. Complex mechanisms and intricate devices are possible here. Lightning crystals power automated tools.

engineering_bench_t3.description: Master engineering station with precision measurement tools and automated assembly assistance.
engineering_bench_t3.name: Master Engineering Station
engineering_bench_t3.narrative: Master engineering station with precision measurement tools and automated assembly assistance.

engineering_bench_t4.name: Arcane Engineering Workshop
engineering_bench_t4.narrative: Legendary engineering workshop that incorporates arcane machinery. Can craft devices that blur the line between magic and technology.

essence_blood.name: Essence Blood
essence_blood.narrative: Crystallized blood from elemental beasts. Pulses with residual power.

eternity_stone.name: Eternity Stone
eternity_stone.narrative: Stone that remembers everything it witnesses. Contains geological memory of eons.

etherion_ingot.name: Etherion Ingot
etherion_ingot.narrative: Reality-bending metal that has transcended conventional physics. Durability frozen in time, effects can occur before cause.

etherion_ore.name: Etherion Ore
etherion_ore.narrative: Metal that simultaneously exists in multiple states. Scholars argue whether it's matter or energy, present or future. It is all of these and none.

fine_scales.name: Fine Scales
fine_scales.narrative: Silvery-white scales with a subtle iridescent sheen. Prized by craftsmen for their flexibility and beauty.

fire_arrow_turret.description: Fire arrow turret with crystal-powered ignition system. Adds a warm touch to home defense. Each arrow trails flames, lighting up enemies and the night.

fire_arrow_turret.name: Fire Arrow Turret
fire_arrow_turret.narrative: Fire arrow turret with crystal-powered ignition system. Adds a warm touch to home defense. Each arrow trails flames, lighting up enemies and the night.

fire_bomb.narrative: Fire bomb with crystal-enhanced payload. Burns hot enough to melt stone. The explosion is just the beginning - the flames linger, hungry.

fire_crystal.narrative: Orange-red crystal pulsing with trapped flames. Warm to touch, occasionally sparks.

fire_resistance_potion.narrative: Fire resistance potion using water and frost essences. Body temperature regulates perfectly. Walk through flames unscathed, fire becomes a gentle warmth.

fire_steel_ingot.name: Fire Steel Ingot
fire_steel_ingot.narrative: Fire-infused steel that burns without being consumed. The metal radiates heat, never cools. Weapons forged from this never need sharpening - they cauterize as they cut.

flamethrower_turret.description: Flamethrower turret that sweeps area with fire. Excellent for crowd control. The roar is almost as terrifying as the flames themselves.

flamethrower_turret.name: Flamethrower Turret
flamethrower_turret.narrative: Flamethrower turret that sweeps area with fire. Excellent for crowd control. The roar is almost as terrifying as the flames themselves.

forge_t1.narrative: Basic stone forge suitable for working copper and iron. The foundation of smithing - crude but functional. Every master started with a forge like this.

forge_t2.narrative: Improved forge with better heat retention and basalt construction. Can work steel reliably. Fire crystals enhance the heat, pushing temperatures higher.

forge_t3.narrative: Master forge with obsidian construction and crystal enhancement. Can reach extreme temperatures needed for legendary metals. Phoenix ash ensures the flames never die.

forge_t4.narrative: Legendary forge that bends reality itself. Can work metals that shouldn't exist. The flames burn with colors that have no name.

frost_mine.narrative: Frost mine that erupts in a blast of ice shards. Triggers on proximity. The cold bites deep, slowing everything it touches.

frost_resistance_potion.narrative: Frost resistance potion using fire crystals to create internal warmth. Cold cannot touch you. Ice shatters against your skin, blizzards feel like spring breezes.

genesis_lattice.narrative: Impossibly perfect geometric form that cannot exist in three-dimensional space, yet here it is.

golem_core.name: Golem Core
golem_core.narrative: Petrified remains from ancient guardians. Contains geological memories.

granite.name: Granite
granite.narrative: Speckled igneous rock with visible crystalline structure. Harder than limestone, more reliable for load-bearing structures.

greater_health_potion.narrative: Powerful healing elixir using essence blood and light gems. Closes wounds rapidly, mends broken bones, restores vitality. The taste of life itself.

healing_beacon.effect: Heals 10 HP/sec in 5 unit radius for 2 minutes
healing_beacon.name: Healing Beacon
healing_beacon.narrative: Healing beacon that emanates restorative energy. Heals allies in radius continuously. The light feels warm, comforting, alive.

health_potion.description: Improved healing potion using water crystals to amplify restorative properties. The liquid shimmers with captured vitality. One swallow and you feel strength returning.
health_potion.name: Health Potion
health_potion.narrative: Improved healing potion using water crystals to amplify restorative properties. The liquid shimmers with captured vitality. One swallow and you feel strength returning.

iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
iron_ore.narrative: Sturdy grey metal from common deposits throughout the land. The workhorse of civilization - reliable, abundant, and strong enough for most purposes.

iron_scales.name: Iron Scales
iron_scales.narrative: Metallic scales from armored creatures. Can deflect sword strikes.

iron_skin_potion.description: Defense-boosting potion using iron scales and earth crystals. Skin hardens like metal, blows that should fell you merely bruise. Stand firm, unbreakable.
iron_skin_potion.name: Iron Skin Potion
iron_skin_potion.narrative: Defense-boosting potion using iron scales and earth crystals. Skin hardens like metal, blows that should fell you merely bruise. Stand firm, unbreakable.

ironwood_log.name: Ironwood Log
ironwood_log.narrative: Rare wood with metallic properties. As hard as soft metals, holds edges almost as well as iron.

ironwood_plank.name: Ironwood Plank
ironwood_plank.narrative: Refined ironwood planks, nearly as strong as actual metal.

laser_turret.description: Laser turret using focused light crystals. Precise and devastating. The beam cuts through armor like it's not even there.
laser_turret.effect: Fires concentrated light beam, 80 damage, 12 unit range
laser_turret.name: Laser Turret
laser_turret.narrative: Laser turret using focused light crystals. Precise and devastating. The beam cuts through armor like it's not even there.

light_gem.name: Light Gem
light_gem.narrative: Radiant crystal glowing with inner light. Pushes back shadows naturally.

lightning_cannon.description: Lightning cannon that channels storm energy. Extremely effective, extremely dangerous. The bolts arc between enemies, chain lightning made manifest.
lightning_cannon.effect: Fires lightning bolts, 70 damage + chain, 10 unit range
lightning_cannon.name: Lightning Cannon
lightning_cannon.narrative: Lightning cannon that channels storm energy. Extremely effective, extremely dangerous. The bolts arc between enemies, chain lightning made manifest.

lightning_shard.narrative: Crackling crystal surrounded by static discharge. Handle with insulated gloves.

limestone.name: Limestone
limestone.narrative: Common sedimentary rock. Soft enough to carve with basic tools yet strong enough for simple construction.

living_ichor.name: Living Ichor
living_ichor.narrative: Concentrated essence that remembers being alive. Key ingredient in high-grade potions.

maple_log.name: Maple Log
maple_log.narrative: Dense hardwood with beautiful figuring. Resists warping and holds its shape through temperature extremes.

maple_plank.name: Maple Plank
maple_plank.narrative: Refined maple planks, ideal for items requiring stability.

marble.name: Marble
marble.narrative: Brilliant white stone that glows faintly with captured sunlight. Used in temples and monuments.

minor_health_potion.description: Basic healing potion from natural herbs and slime gel. Every alchemist's first creation. Tastes terrible, works wonderfully. Wounds close and pain fades within moments.
minor_health_potion.name: Minor Health Potion
minor_health_potion.narrative: Basic healing potion from natural herbs and slime gel. Every alchemist's first creation. Tastes terrible, works wonderfully. Wounds close and pain fades within moments.

mithril_ingot.name: Mithril Ingot
mithril_ingot.narrative: Refined mithril that whispers of ancient secrets. Perfect for weapons that need both power and grace.

mithril_ore.name: Mithril Ore
mithril_ore.narrative: Legendary silver-white metal that seems to drink in moonlight and starshine. Impossibly light yet incredibly strong.

mithril_scales.name: Mithril Scales
mithril_scales.narrative: Luminous scales that seem to drink in moonlight. Found on fish from the deepest, purest waters.

net_launcher.description: Net launcher that ensnares enemies. Reduces movement speed dramatically. Spectral thread nets are nearly unbreakable.
net_launcher.effect: Fires net that slows enemies by 80% for 10 seconds
net_launcher.name: Net Launcher
net_launcher.narrative: Net launcher that ensnares enemies. Reduces movement speed dramatically. Spectral thread nets are nearly unbreakable.

oak_log.name: Oak Log

oak_plank.name: Oak Plank
oak_plank.narrative: Refined oak planks with improved durability and quality.

obsidian.name: Obsidian

orichalcum_ingot.name: Orichalcum Ingot
orichalcum_ingot.narrative: The pinnacle of mortal metallurgy. Channels both physical force and magical energy with perfect efficiency.

orichalcum_ore.name: Orichalcum Ore
orichalcum_ore.narrative: Gleaming golden metal with an otherworldly green-blue sheen. Ancient civilizations built empires on its discovery.

orichalcum_scales.name: Orichalcum Scales
orichalcum_scales.narrative: Golden-green scales with an otherworldly shimmer. Said to come from fish blessed by ancient water spirits.

phoenix_ash.name: Phoenix Ash
phoenix_ash.narrative: Ash-grey substance from legendary phoenix nests. Burns eternally without being consumed.

pine_log.name: Pine Log
pine_log.narrative: Light, flexible wood harvested from tall conifers. Works easily under a blade, bends without breaking.

pine_plank.name: Pine Plank
pine_plank.narrative: Refined pine planks, perfect for bows and flexible constructions.

primordial_crystal.name: Primordial Crystal
primordial_crystal.narrative: Suspended in perpetual crystallization. Neither fully solid nor energy, exists in quantum superposition.

primordial_scales.name: Primordial Scales
primordial_scales.narrative: Scales that phase in and out of existence. Harvested from fish that swim between dimensions.

refinery_t1.narrative: Basic limestone refinery for turning raw ores into usable ingots. Essential for any metalworker. The crucible glows red-hot as impurities burn away.

refinery_t2.narrative: Advanced refinery with improved efficiency and heat control. Can process higher-grade ores and create complex alloys. The granite construction handles intense heat without cracking.

refinery_t3.name: Master Refinery
refinery_t3.narrative: Master refinery capable of processing legendary materials. Obsidian crucibles contain temperatures that would vaporize lesser equipment. Mithril chambers prevent contamination.

refinery_t4.narrative: Legendary refinery that exists partially outside normal reality. Can process materials that shouldn't be refinable.

regeneration_tonic.name: Regeneration Tonic
regeneration_tonic.narrative: Regeneration tonic that mends wounds over time. Light gems infused with living essence create a sustained healing effect. Your body remembers how to heal itself.

shadow_core.narrative: Crystallized darkness that absorbs light. Uncomfortable to look at directly.

shale.name: Shale

simple_bomb.name: Simple Bomb
simple_bomb.narrative: Simple explosive using blast powder in iron casing. The universal problem solver. Pull pin, throw, run. In that order.

slime_gel.narrative: Translucent gelatinous substance. Surprisingly elastic and adhesive when processed.

spectral_thread.name: Spectral Thread
spectral_thread.narrative: Ethereal substance from creatures between worlds. Exists partially out of phase.

spike_trap.name: Spike Trap
spike_trap.narrative: Spike trap with spring-loaded iron spikes. Triggers on contact. Simple, brutal, effective. The spikes punch through leather and flesh alike.

steel_ingot.name: Steel Ingot

steel_ore.name: Steel Ore

steel_scales.name: Steel Scales

storm_heart.name: Storm Heart
storm_heart.narrative: Captured lightning from primordial storms. Contains raw creation energy.

test_trap_conflicting_status.narrative: Tests conflicting status effects (freeze + burn + slow + root).

test_turret_beam_burn.narrative: Beam geometry with burn status effect.

test_turret_no_tags.narrative: Turret with NO tags to test fallback behavior.

tin_ingot.name: Tin Ingot
tin_ingot.narrative: Refined tin with excellent magical conductivity. Used in alloys and enchanted items.

tin_ore.name: Tin Ore
tin_ore.narrative: Soft, silvery-white metal with a mysterious sheen that glows faintly in moonlight. Ancient texts speak of its lunar affinity.

titans_brew.description: Legendary brew combining dragon essence with phoenix ash. Maximum HP surges, strength magnifies. For a brief time, you become something more than mortal.
titans_brew.name: Titan's Brew
titans_brew.narrative: Legendary brew combining dragon essence with phoenix ash. Maximum HP surges, strength magnifies. For a brief time, you become something more than mortal.

universal_solvent.description: Creating universal solvent that can dissolve anything. Handle with extreme care. The void essence makes it unstable, the shadow core makes it hungry. It wants to unmake things.
universal_solvent.effect: Can dissolve most materials, use carefully
universal_solvent.name: Universal Solvent
universal_solvent.narrative: Creating universal solvent that can dissolve anything. Handle with extreme care. The void essence makes it unstable, the shadow core makes it hungry. It wants to unmake things.

void_essence.name: Void Essence
void_essence.narrative: Liquid darkness given physical form. Absorbs heat, light, and hope.

voidstone.name: Voidstone
voidstone.narrative: Pitch-black stone that seems to pull light into itself. Radiates subtle wrongness.

water_crystal.name: Water Crystal
water_crystal.narrative: Blue crystal filled with flowing liquid. Cool and calming, perpetually damp.

weapon_oil.description: Oil that makes weapons strike true. Edges stay sharp impossibly long. Warriors whisper prayers to the alchemist who made this.
weapon_oil.effect: Apply to weapons for +10% damage for 2 hours
weapon_oil.name: Weapon Oil
weapon_oil.narrative: Oil that makes weapons strike true. Edges stay sharp impossibly long. Warriors whisper prayers to the alchemist who made this.

wolf_pelt.name: Wolf Pelt
wolf_pelt.narrative: Rough grey pelt from common wolves. Durable but coarse, requires treatment to soften.

worldtree_log.name: Worldtree Log
worldtree_log.narrative: Living wood from the World Tree's roots. Contains millennia of accumulated magical essence.

worldtree_plank.name: Worldtree Plank
worldtree_plank.narrative: Refined worldtree planks that remember their connection to the source.
